# SEO仍是基础：如何结合AEO与GEO使用

作者：@dylandgtl  
日期：2026-10-31（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/dylandgtl/status/2116240958736183470)  
分类：工具推广

## 中文全文

一位客户在 Google 上搜索所在城市的某项服务。另一位客户则问 ChatGPT，应该考虑哪家服务商。

两者都是潜在客户。但如果你的可见性策略止步于关键词排名报告，你衡量的就只是他们发现你这家企业的部分途径。

SEO 仍然是基础。AEO 和 GEO 则拓展了你需要就内容和可见性提出的问题。

这正是 Elevate SEO 背后的思路。这套工具是我在经营一家只有自己一个人的营销代理公司时开发的。

利益披露：我是创始人。下文的业务场景是示例，并非客户案例研究，也不是对结果的承诺。

## SEO、AEO 和 GEO 协同发挥作用

**SEO** 帮助搜索引擎发现、理解并展示你的网站。

**AEO**，即答案引擎优化，重点是让信息在直接回答问题的体验中发挥作用。

**GEO**，即生成式引擎优化，重点是生成式 AI 回答中的可见性，包括提及和引用。

这些做法存在重叠。Google 表示，基础 SEO 仍然适用于它的 AI 功能，AI Overviews 或 AI Mode 不要求特殊优化。[developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

机会在于：以这些基础为起点，让信息更加清晰，并扩大衡量范围。

## 1. 先改好已有页面

假设卡尔加里的一家医美机构，希望让更多人关注自己的皮肤治疗服务。

再发一篇文章可能有帮助。不过，首先应检查已有服务页面是否清楚解释了治疗项目，以及有没有值得处理的技术问题。

Elevate SEO 可以审计单个页面，也可以每次抓取最多 15 个页面，并给出与受影响页面对应的发现。

在我自己网站的审计中，行动计划指出了页面标题修改、结构化数据建议，以及回答客户问题的机会。

这是 Elevate SEO 对我网站给出的内部健康评分和建议修改项。

对于这家医美机构，下一步可以检查治疗页面是否解释了流程、咨询要求、资质和地点。

随后，关键词研究和内容简报可以帮助探索相关搜索和问题。诊所提供准确的治疗信息，代理公司审核并落实修改。

这样，更新的目的就不只是增加关键词。

## 2. 了解自己在 Google 和地图中的可见性

一家服务周边多个区域的美发店，需要的背景信息不只是一个排名数字。

从重要服务和重点地点开始。记录设备和位置设置，使后续检查可以相互比较。

Elevate SEO 的 Google 排名与地图检查可以帮助建立这一基线。它的商家资料检查会补充类别、营业时间、照片和服务信息，并将评论数量和评分与本地前三名比较。

例如，一家美发店可以研究自己在“hair salon Calgary（卡尔加里美发店）”和若干服务类搜索中的可见性，再检查资料缺口和相关竞争对手。

这些发现可以指导决策，但不能证明某个缺失的资料字段造成了更低的排名。

关键词研究也能补充背景。Elevate SEO 会显示意图、搜索量、难度、CPC 和趋势，但在展示需求估算之前，要先确认这些数据覆盖的地理范围。

这个示例报告的是加拿大全国的搜索量，而不是仅限温哥华的数据。

## 3. 研究 AI 回答究竟说了什么

现在，想象一位潜在客户问：

“温哥华的小企业应该考虑哪些营销代理公司？”

Google 排名报告不会告诉你，哪些企业出现在这条回答里。

Elevate SEO 会把客户问题交给 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Perplexity，让你查看被点名的企业，并检查可用的信息来源。

在对我自己代理公司的检查中，三个回答都没有引用我的网站。来源包括目录网站、代理公司的文章和竞争对手页面。

这是展示 AI 回答及其返回来源的一张快照。

这给了我具体的研究任务：查看那些页面，检查相关商家目录信息，并比较竞争对手网站对其服务的解释是否更清晰。

Elevate SEO 的竞品发现和外链比较可以支持这项研究。如果某个目录链接到了竞争对手，它就成为一个值得评估的候选渠道，而不是意味着你必须自动去争取同样的链接。

AI 的回答会变化。要保持问题一致，并区分提及、引用和推荐。

## 把发现转化为有用的工作

你可以在 Elevate SEO 仪表盘中查看结果，也可以通过 MCP，把它的工具连接到兼容的 AI 工作流中，包括 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor。

请你的助手推荐三个优先事项，指出支撑证据，并标出所有需要核实的地方。

然后批准建议、落实修改，并记录发生了什么。Elevate SEO 提供发现和建议，但不会编辑你的网站。

重复进行相关检查，并单独检查咨询或销售情况。仅有可见性，并不能证明业务结果。

**继续问自己排在哪里，同时也要问：客户能够理解什么，AI 回答实际展示了什么。**

这就是 [Elevate SEO](https://seo.elevatedm.ca/) 帮你建立的更完整工作流程：将网站审计、排名、研究和 AI 可见性检查放进同一套工具里。

## 外文原文

A customer searches Google for a service in their city. Another asks ChatGPT which provider to consider.

Both are potential customers. But if your visibility strategy ends with a keyword ranking report, you’re only measuring part of how they might discover your business.

SEO remains the foundation. AEO and GEO expand the questions you ask about your content and visibility.

That’s the thinking behind Elevate SEO, the toolkit I built while running a one-person marketing agency.

Disclosure: I’m the founder. The business scenarios below are examples, not customer case studies or promised results.

## SEO, AEO, and GEO work together

**SEO** helps search engines discover, understand, and surface your website.

**AEO**, or Answer Engine Optimization, focuses on making information useful in experiences that answer questions directly.

**GEO**, or Generative Engine Optimization, focuses on visibility in generative AI responses, including mentions and citations.

These practices overlap. Google says foundational SEO remains relevant to its AI features, without special optimizations required for AI Overviews or AI Mode. [developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The opportunity is to build on those foundations with clearer information and broader measurement.

## 1. Fix the pages you already have

Imagine a Calgary med spa wants more attention for its skin treatments.

Publishing another article might help. First, though, check whether the existing service pages explain the treatments clearly and have technical issues worth addressing.

Elevate SEO can audit individual pages or crawl up to 15 pages per run, producing findings tied to affected pages.

In my own website audit, the action plan flagged page-title revisions, structured-data recommendations, and opportunities to answer customer questions.

Elevate SEO’s internal health score and recommended changes for my website.

For the med spa, the next step could be reviewing whether its treatment page explains the process, consultation requirements, qualifications, and location.

Keyword research and a content brief can then help investigate relevant searches and questions. The clinic supplies the accurate treatment information; the agency reviews and implements changes.

That gives the update a purpose beyond adding keywords.

## 2. Understand your Google and Maps visibility

A salon serving several nearby areas needs more context than one ranking number.

Start with important services and priority locations. Record the device and location settings so future checks are comparable.

Elevate SEO’s Google ranking and Maps checks help establish that baseline. Its Business Profile check adds information about categories, hours, photos, and services, alongside review-count and rating comparisons with the local top three.

For example, a salon could investigate its visibility for “hair salon Calgary” and selected service searches, then review profile gaps and relevant competitors.

Those findings guide decisions. They don’t prove that one missing profile detail caused a lower position.

Keyword research adds context, too. Elevate SEO displays intent, volume, difficulty, CPC, and trends, but read the geographic scope before presenting demand estimates.

This example reports Canada-wide search volumes, not Vancouver-only figures.

## 3. Investigate what AI answers say

Now imagine a prospective client asks:

“Which marketing agencies should I consider for a small business in Vancouver?”

Your Google ranking report won’t tell you which businesses appear in that response.

Elevate SEO runs customer questions through ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity so you can review the businesses named and inspect available sources.

In my agency check, none of the three answers cited my website. The sources included directories, agency articles, and competitor pages.

A snapshot showing sources returned alongside AI answers.

That gave me specific research tasks: inspect those pages, check relevant business listings, and compare how clearly competing websites explain their services.

Elevate SEO’s competitor discovery and backlink comparisons can support that investigation. A directory linking to a competitor becomes a candidate to evaluate, rather than an automatic instruction to pursue the same link.

AI answers vary. Keep questions consistent and distinguish mentions, citations, and recommendations.

## Turn the findings into useful work

You can review results in Elevate SEO’s dashboard or connect its tools to compatible AI workflows through MCP, including Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

Ask your assistant to recommend three priorities, identify the supporting evidence, and flag anything requiring verification.

Then approve the recommendations, implement changes, and record what happened. Elevate SEO provides findings and advice; it doesn’t edit your website.

Repeat relevant checks and review enquiries or sales separately. Visibility alone doesn’t establish business results.

**Keep asking where you rank. Add questions about what customers can understand and what AI answers actually show.**

That’s the broader workflow [Elevate SEO](https://seo.elevatedm.ca/) helps you build: website audits, rankings, research, and AI visibility checks in one toolkit.
